about: The Android port's touch points in upstream SolidCraft: every upstream file the port changes belongs to one area, and each area names the tests that prove it still works after a merge. Read by scripts/android-port.py (docs/android-sync.md, 'How the port stays mergeable'). Files only the port has (apps/solidcraft-android, the port's docs, pending files) need no entry.

upstream_failures.why: trips egui's debug assertion in the test harness; fails the same on a clean upstream checkout (0.22.0 to 0.25.1)

egui's 'Dropped TexturesDelta with unapplied deltas' assertion in the test harness; fails the same on a clean upstream 0.30.1 checkout

areas.name: Touch input
areas.why: One finger orbits, two pan, a pinch zooms; the view bar's crosshair button lets a finger pick; a finger drags a dialog's arrows and scrolls a drop-down; the patched winit gives the mouse and keyboard
tests: solidcraft-ui-egui --lib one_finger_drag_orbits two_fingers_pan_and_pinch a_tap_selects pinch_gesture a_tap_picks_a_profile a_finger_on_the_arrow_stem a_finger_scrolls_a_tall_drop_down the_crosshair_button_lets_a_finger_pick

markers.pattern: SolidCraft Android port\); the pin still pins

areas.name: Design files
areas.why: Designs saved by earlier port releases keep opening: their retired helical-thread changes are known (crates/doc/src/port_retired.rs), and the threads become upstream's modelled threads

areas.name: Agents and the MCP server
areas.why: Settings > MCP server; agent commands, timed batches too, compute off the window thread
tests: solidcraft-mcp --lib handshake_and_tools_list a_request_still_running_is_left_to_the_pending_tool pending_is_empty_headless remote_engine_batch_is_not_resent_after_a_lost_reply running_asks_the_app running_is_asked_at_once auto_session_bridges_to_a_late_app

areas.name: Crash reports
areas.why: Port issue #4: a report saves a copy through the system's picker (Android has no folder to open), and Report drafts the issue on the port's tracker on Android

markers.pattern: SolidCraft Android port: no folder to open there
SolidCraft Android port: the port's crashes go to the port's tracker

areas.name: OpenGL ES
areas.why: The viewport shader compiles on OpenGL ES (the fallback for GPUs whose Vulkan fails, port issue #4): no `invariant` on a fragment input, which naga writes and GLES refuses

areas.name: The Android build
areas.why: Crates and settings the Android app needs: no arboard there, Android's system fonts, the patched winit, the port's app registered with the repository checks

areas.name: GPU tessellation
areas.why: Bodies are built on the CPU where the driver crashes compiling upstream 0.40's evaluation shader (Adreno 840 on a Galaxy Z Fold: a null read in vkCreateComputePipelines); a launch that died compiling it leaves a marker, and later launches skip it

markers.pattern: SolidCraft \(Android port\): also where the driver crashes compiling it

areas.name: Plugins
areas.why: Plugins install on Android: upstream's plugins folder is under $XDG_DATA_HOME or $HOME, which Android doesn't set, so the app names its own private folder

markers.pattern: SolidCraft Android port: the plugins folder an app names
SolidCraft Android port: the app's own folder
